title: Multi-Horizon Explainable Queue Forecasting and Resource-Aware Decision Support for Intelligent Border Control Using LightGBM
abstract: arXiv:2610.15930v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Border crossing points are stochastic service systems in which traffic demand, traveler categories, registration status, inspection requirements, staffing, and lane availability interact on multiple time scales. This paper extends an earlier multimodal queue-management framework by introducing an implementation-oriented, multi-horizon forecasting and decision-support architecture based on Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) models. In contrast to a single forecasting block, the proposed approach constructs horizon-specific regressors for 15, 30, 60, and 120 min forecasts and jointly estimates future waiting time and queue lengths. The models operate on temporally lagged traffic, service, density, and queue features, while an operational layer incorporates lane compatibility, officer availability, possibly degraded resources, traveler category, preregistration information, and human-approval constraints. translated_title: 基于LightGBM的智能边境控制多时间跨度可解释队列预测与资源感知决策支持
translated_abstract: 边境检查点是随机服务系统，其中交通需求、旅客类别、注册状态、检查要求、人员配置和通道可用性在多个时间尺度上相互作用。本文通过引入一种面向实施的、基于轻量梯度提升机（LightGBM）模型的多时间跨度预测与决策支持架构，扩展了早期的多模态队列管理框架。与单一预测模块不同，所提出的方法为15、30、60和120分钟的预测构建了针对特定时间跨度的回归器，并联合估计未来等待时间和队列长度。这些模型基于时间滞后的交通、服务、密度和队列特征进行运行，而操作层则纳入了通道兼容性、工作人员可用性、可能降级的资源、旅客类别、预注册信息以及人工审批约束。分位数LightGBM模型……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于LightGBM的多时间跨度（15/30/60/120分钟）可解释队列预测与资源感知决策支持架构，联合预测边境口岸的未来等待时间和队列长度，并将通道兼容性、人员可用性和人工审批等运营约束纳入决策，服务于智能边境控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a LightGBM-based multi-horizon explainable queue forecasting and resource-aware decision-support architecture for intelligent border control, which jointly predicts future waiting times and queue lengths at 15/30/60/120-minute horizons while incorporating operational constraints such as lane compatibility, officer availability, and human-approval requirements.
